title.narrative: Strengthening Syrians lives through Integrated Humanitarian support

description.narrative: ltpgtThis project aims at supporting 5 locations (4 in Rural Damascus and one in Aleppo) with integrated services under food, Protection, education and multi-purpose cash sectors. It will target Returnees, IDPS, and Host communityltbrgtTo ensure an integrated response that addresses the multifaceted needs of affected populations, the proposed intervention strategically links activities across sectors in each location. MPC will prioritise people with protection risks (GBV, CP) to reduces resort to harmful coping strategies, it will also prioritise families with dropped out children, MPC can reduce school dropouts by covering education-related expenses, cash will also empower households to meet food needs according to their preferences, improving dignity and nutritional diversity. Protection interventions, including case management and psychosocial support, will be integrated into education settings to create safe, inclusive learning environments for children, particularly those at risk of exploitation or neglect.ltbrgtFood assistance will reduce reliance on harmful coping mechanisms, such as child labor and early marriage, thereby reinforcing protection outcomes.ltbrgtthis will be achieved through the following activities in each location:ltbrgtIn Altal:ltbrgtAltamayoz has a center in Altal that contains a WGSS funded by UNFPA, the complimentary activities will be implemented in a different zone in the same building, interventions have been discussed with sector coordinators and (DoE) and will include:ltbrgt-Providing Education services in the center and in one public school to be determined later by DoE, services will include nor formal education activities with stationary distribution, in addition to capacity building for teachersltbrgt-Food support will be provided to 300 families through food baskets for 8 roundsltbrgtProtection services will enhance education and will be as an entry point for MPC beneficiaries who will be referred from GBV CM, education, and food assistance activities, Protection activities will include awareness raising on GP, MA, and will support community initiativesltbrgt- CP activities will be provided through a mobile team in Maaraba community after consultations with CP coordinator and other actors in the arealtbrgt- In BabillaltbrgtAltamayoz has a center that is currently providing health and GBV services, the aim of this project is to continue providing the needed GBV services after the current project comes to its end by Jan 2026, and to expand services to include CP,MA,GP, education and MPC .ltbrgtIn Ain elfigeh, Proposed activities aim to provide the needed protection services after the current project comes to its end by Jan 2026, and to expand services to include GP, MA, and MPC, through which protection, education and food situations will be enhanced as mentioned aboveltbrgtGBV activities in 2 areas in Rural Damascus (Babilla and Ein elfijeh) will be as a continuation of the already existing services being implemented under SHF project which will end in Jan 2026, so this activity will start from February 2026 in Rural Damascus as consulted with SHF and project coordinatorltbrgtIn Ghizlanyyeh, and after consultation with protection sectors and CP actors in the area INTERSOSS INGO it has been agreed that INTERSOSS will provide health and protection services while Altamayoz will support education through supporting 2 schools in Alghizlanyeh in coordination with DoE. Education services will include remedial classes and stationary distributionltbrgtIn AleppoltbrgtGBV activities will start from Jan 2026 as consulted with SHF team, they are to continue supporting the WGSS currently running under UNFPA which will end in Sep 2025ltbrgtChild protection activities will be implemented through a sub partner (Bateel Organization) that will target vulnerable children in Aleppo city along with integration of children with disabilities (From Alrajaa organization) with CP activities in order to give good and new hope for those who have integration abilities. ltbrgtlt/pgt
